title: Troubleshoot a new technology from English docs
summary: Đọc documentation, tạo hypothesis và thử nghiệm an toàn mà không cần bản dịch.

sections.title: Worker retry documentation
sections.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. A failed attempt occurs when the handler returns an error or throws an uncaught exception, and either outcome is eligible for retry. maxAttempts is the total number of attempts and includes the initial attempt. A job moves to the dead-letter queue after all configured attempts fail. Setting maxAttempts to 1 allows only the initial attempt and therefore disables retries. Effective configuration may differ by environment.

expressions.meaning: Separate a documented rule from a hypothesis about the current system.
expressions.example: The documentation establishes that maxAttempts includes the initial attempt.

expressions.meaning: Frame a possible cause without presenting it as confirmed.
expressions.example: One testable hypothesis is that staging has maxAttempts set to one.
alternatives: A plausible explanation to test is ___.

expressions.phrase: This hypothesis would be supported if ___ and rejected if ___.
expressions.meaning: Define observable evidence for both outcomes.
expressions.example: This hypothesis would be supported if the effective value is one and rejected if it is already above one.
alternatives: The expected signal is ___; otherwise I would investigate ___.

exercises.question: Vì sao job có thể không retry?
options: The handler throws instead of returning an error.
exercises.explanation: Giá trị 1 chỉ cho phép initial attempt; cả returned error và uncaught exception đều đủ điều kiện retry.

exercises.question: Which handler outcome counts as a failed attempt?
options: Only returning an error; thrown exceptions are ignored.
Either returning an error or throwing an uncaught exception.
Returning a success value even when an error message appears in the log output.
correctAnswer: Either returning an error or throwing an uncaught exception.
exercises.explanation: The documentation explicitly gives return-or-throw semantics; a success return is not a failed attempt merely because a log contains an error.

exercises.question: With maxAttempts=3, how many total attempts are allowed?
options: Four: one initial attempt plus three retries.
exercises.explanation: maxAttempts is defined as the total number of attempts, not the number of retries after the initial attempt.

performanceTask.title: Plan a safe troubleshooting experiment
performanceTask.scenario: Một worker mới không retry như nhóm kỳ vọng; bạn có documentation và symptom, nhưng effective config chưa được xác nhận.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: Read the documentation once, hide it, then write a diagnostic plan without the model.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: Viết bằng tiếng Anh: tóm tắt rule từ docs, nêu hypothesis, cách kiểm tra an toàn, expected signal, rejection signal và rollback.
performanceTask.modelResponse: The documentation says a handler that returns an error or throws an uncaught exception creates a failed attempt. maxAttempts is the total attempt count, including the initial attempt, so a value of one disables retries. My first hypothesis is that this environment has an effective value of one, but the documentation alone does not prove the current setting. I would inspect the effective staging configuration before changing anything. If it confirms the hypothesis, I would use an isolated queue to enqueue one synthetic job whose handler throws, with maxAttempts=3. The expected signal is three recorded failed attempts followed by dead-lettering. I would record the job ID, avoid production traffic, restore the previous configuration, remove the synthetic job and confirm normal dispatch after cleanup. If the effective value is already above one, I would reject this hypothesis and inspect the handler’s observed return-or-throw behavior.
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Sửa kế hoạch để tách doc fact, hypothesis, expected signal và cleanup.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: Docs của một cache nói TTL=0 means no expiry. Viết kế hoạch kiểm tra an toàn cho bug stale data.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Từ unseen docs đã đọc một lần, tạo hypothesis và safe experiment có expected signal.

artifacts.title: Cache TTL documentation
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. TTL is measured in seconds. TTL=0 means entries do not expire automatically. cache.invalidate(key) removes one entry. The effective TTL can be inspected with cachectl describe --key KEY.

artifacts.title: Circuit breaker documentation
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. The breaker opens after five failures in thirty seconds. It remains open for coolDownSeconds, then permits one probe request. A successful probe closes the breaker; a failed probe reopens it.

trainingSource.title: Batch concurrency documentation
trainingSource.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. concurrency controls simultaneous jobs. A value of zero pauses dispatch without deleting queued jobs. Changes apply to new dispatches only. Use scheduler status to confirm active and queued counts.

extractionItems.question: What does concurrency zero do?
extractionItems.feedback: The docs separate dispatch from queue retention.

extractionItems.question: When does a changed value apply?
extractionItems.feedback: The scope limits the expected signal.

extractionItems.question: What verifies the behavior?
extractionItems.feedback: The status command supplies observable evidence.
